text.hi: राहुल की बात अनिल को बताओ। I → he, my → his, और काम का समय पीछे जाता है: like → liked, would like → would like। किताब का उदाहरण: Rahul said that he visited Kanha Kisli during the holidays.
text.hinglish: Rahul ki baat Anil ko batao. I → he, my → his, aur kaam ka samay peechhe jaata hai: like → liked, would like → would like. Kitaab ka udaaharan: Rahul said that he visited Kanha Kisli during the holidays.
text.en: Tell Anil what Rahul said. I → he, my → his, and the tense moves back. The book's example: Rahul said that he visited Kanha Kisli during the holidays.
